致所有热爱《安尼姆》的玩家：
这一次，我们做了款永不落幕的单机版！
各位新老玩家朋友们，好久不见。
为什么我们要把《安尼姆的无尽旅途》从网游改成单机版？
其实原因很简单，也很纯粹：
一是想给一直支持我们的玩家，留一个"可以持续游玩的地方"。不用再担心服务器关闭，某天突然就玩不到了，这份陪伴不该被运营问题打断；
二是想弥补遗憾。网游版的运营一直举步维艰，更让我们愧疚的是，当初的设计框架导致游戏体验不够稳定，这些问题困扰了大家很久，也成了我们心里的疙瘩。所以我们想在最后，把游戏最基础、最核心的体验做好，完整地交到喜欢《安尼姆》的人手里。这是我们项目组能做，也应该做的事。
从网游到单机，这是一次艰难的转型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我们深知这款游戏还不够完美，但它始终承载着"不让热爱落幕"的初心。如果你是老玩家，欢迎回来重拾回忆；如果你喜欢暗黑地牢类游戏，也期待你能来探索这个世界。
下面和大家详细说说单机版的核心改动，每一处都为了更纯粹的游玩体验：
1、彻底删除所有氪金系统，买断制一次付费，畅玩到底；
2、新增"游戏月"机制：替代原网游24小时现实刷新，主线需在倒计时内完成（简单/普通难度时间充裕，高难度更具挑战），同时承载游戏内刷新功能；
3、角色全免费招募：取消固定角色徽章，改为通用徽章升级，招募与升级方式需要大家自行探索；
4、新增旁白系统：强化剧情沉浸感，带你更深入走进安尼姆的世界；
5、角色永久死亡：一旦阵亡无法复活、无法重招，每一步选择都要谨慎；
6、即时存档功能：随开随玩；
7、装备系统优化：提升罗盘秘境产出，降低装备打磨成本和火炼难度，减负更护肝。
我们知道，这次转型可能会有不完美的地方，但每一处改动都凝聚着我们的诚意。老玩家们，这里依然是你们熟悉的安尼姆，却有了更纯粹的冒险；新朋友们，欢迎你们加入这场旅途。

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

這一次，我們做了款永不落幕的單機版！

其實原因很簡單，也很純粹：

從網游到單機，這是一次艱難的轉型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我們深知這款遊戲還不夠完美，但它始終承載著「不讓熱愛落幕」的初心。如果你是老玩家，歡迎回來重拾回憶；如果你喜歡暗黑地牢類遊戲，也期待你能來探索這個世界。
下面和大家詳細說說單機版的核心改動，每一處都為了更純粹的遊玩體驗：
徹底刪除所有氪金系統，買斷制一次付費，暢玩到底；
新增「遊戲月」機制：替代原網游24小時現實刷新，主線需在倒計時內完成（簡單/普通難度時間充裕，高難度更具挑戰），同時承載遊戲內刷新功能；
角色全免費招募：取消固定角色徽章，改為通用徽章升級，招募與升級方式需要大家自行探索；
新增旁白系統：強化劇情沉浸感，帶你更深入走進安尼姆的世界；
角色永久死亡：一旦陣亡無法復活、無法重招，每一步選擇都要謹慎；
即時存檔功能：隨開隨玩；
裝備系統優化：提升羅盤秘境產出，降低裝備打磨成本和火煉難度，減負更護肝。
我們知道，這次轉型可能會有不完美的地方，但每一處改動都凝聚著我們的誠意。老玩家們，這裡依然是你們熟悉的安尼姆，卻有了更純粹的冒險；新朋友們，歡迎你們加入這場旅途。

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

致所有熱愛《安尼姆》的玩家：
這一次，我們做了款永不落幕的單機版！
各位新老玩家朋友們，好久不見。
為什麼我們要把《安尼姆的無盡旅途》從網游改成單機版？
其實原因很簡單，也很純粹：
一是想給一直支持我們的玩家，留一個「可以持續遊玩的地方」。不用再擔心服務器關閉，某天突然就玩不到了，這份陪伴不該被運營問題打斷；
二是想彌補遺憾。網游版的運營一直舉步維艱，更讓我們愧疚的是，當初的設計框架導致遊戲體驗不夠穩定，這些問題困擾了大家很久，也成了我們心裡的疙瘩。所以我們想在最後，把遊戲最基礎、最核心的體驗做好，完整地交到喜歡《安尼姆》的人手裡。這是我們項目組能做，也應該做的事。
從網游到單機，這是一次艱難的轉型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我們深知這款遊戲還不夠完美，但它始終承載著「不讓熱愛落幕」的初心。如果你是老玩家，歡迎回來重拾回憶；如果你喜歡暗黑地牢類遊戲，也期待你能來探索這個世界。
下面和大家詳細說說單機版的核心改動，每一處都為了更純粹的遊玩體驗：
徹底刪除所有氪金系統，買斷制一次付費，暢玩到底；
新增「遊戲月」機制：替代原網游24小時現實刷新，主線需在倒計時內完成（簡單/普通難度時間充裕，高難度更具挑戰），同時承載遊戲內刷新功能；
角色全免費招募：取消固定角色徽章，改為通用徽章升級，招募與升級方式需要大家自行探索；
新增旁白系統：強化劇情沉浸感，帶你更深入走進安尼姆的世界；
角色永久死亡：一旦陣亡無法復活、無法重招，每一步選擇都要謹慎；
即時存檔功能：隨開隨玩；
裝備系統優化：提升羅盤秘境產出，降低裝備打磨成本和火煉難度，減負更護肝。
我們知道，這次轉型可能會有不完美的地方，但每一處改動都凝聚著我們的誠意。老玩家們，這裡依然是你們熟悉的安尼姆，卻有了更純粹的冒險；新朋友們，歡迎你們加入這場旅途。

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

致所有熱愛《安尼姆》的玩家：
這一次，我們做了款永不落幕的單機版！
各位新老玩家朋友們，好久不見。
為什麼我們要把《安尼姆的無盡旅途》從網游改成單機版？
其實原因很簡單，也很純粹：
一是想給一直支持我們的玩家，留一個「可以持續遊玩的地方」。不用再擔心服務器關閉，某天突然就玩不到了，這份陪伴不該被運營問題打斷；
二是想彌補遺憾。網游版的運營一直舉步維艱，更讓我們愧疚的是，當初的設計框架導致遊戲體驗不夠穩定，這些問題困擾了大家很久，也成了我們心裡的疙瘩。所以我們想在最後，把遊戲最基礎、最核心的體驗做好，完整地交到喜歡《安尼姆》的人手裡。這是我們項目組能做，也應該做的事。
從網游到單機，這是一次艱難的轉型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我們深知這款遊戲還不夠完美，但它始終承載著「不讓熱愛落幕」的初心。如果你是老玩家，歡迎回來重拾回憶；如果你喜歡暗黑地牢類遊戲，也期待你能來探索這個世界。
下面和大家詳細說說單機版的核心改動，每一處都為了更純粹的遊玩體驗：
徹底刪除所有氪金系統，買斷制一次付費，暢玩到底；
新增「遊戲月」機制：替代原網游24小時現實刷新，主線需在倒計時內完成（簡單/普通難度時間充裕，高難度更具挑戰），同時承載遊戲內刷新功能；
角色全免費招募：取消固定角色徽章，改為通用徽章升級，招募與升級方式需要大家自行探索；
新增旁白系統：強化劇情沉浸感，帶你更深入走進安尼姆的世界；
角色永久死亡：一旦陣亡無法復活、無法重招，每一步選擇都要謹慎；
即時存檔功能：隨開隨玩；
裝備系統優化：提升羅盤秘境產出，降低裝備打磨成本和火煉難度，減負更護肝。
我們知道，這次轉型可能會有不完美的地方，但每一處改動都凝聚著我們的誠意。老玩家們，這裡依然是你們熟悉的安尼姆，卻有了更純粹的冒險；新朋友們，歡迎你們加入這場旅途。

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

us.description:
To every player who loves DongWu: This time, we made a single-player version that never ends.
Dear old friends and new adventurers — it’s been a while.
Why did we turn DongWu Odyssey from an online game into a single-player title?
The reason is simple, and honestly, quite pure.
First, we wanted to give the players who’ve always supported us a place to keep playing — forever. No more worrying about the servers shutting down, no more waking up one day to find you can’t log in. This companionship shouldn’t be cut short by operational problems.
Second, we wanted to make things right. The online version struggled to stay afloat, and what weighs on us even more is that the original design framework led to an unstable experience. Those issues troubled all of you for far too long, and they’ve been a knot in our hearts ever since. So we decided that, at the very end, we would nail the most fundamental, core experience of the game and hand it over, fully and completely, to everyone who loves DongWu. This is something our team can do, and something we should do.
From online to single-player — this is a difficult transformation, but also a brave rebirth. We know this game is still far from perfect, yet it has always carried the original intention of "never letting passion fade." If you’re a returning player, welcome back to relive your memories. If you love Darkest Dungeon-style games, we hope you’ll come explore this world.
Here are the core changes in the single-player version — every one of them made for a more pure playing experience:
All monetization removed. Pay once, play forever. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.
New "Game Month" system: Replaces the old 24-hour real-time refresh cycle. Main story progress must be completed within a countdown timer (Easy/Normal difficulties are forgiving; Hard mode truly tests you). Also handles in-game refresh functions.
All characters freely recruitable: Fixed character badges are gone. Now a universal badge system handles upgrades — how to recruit and level up is for you to discover.
New narrator system: Deepens story immersion and pulls you deeper into the world of DongWu.
Permanent death: Once a character falls, they’re gone for good — no resurrection, no re-recruitment. Every step demands caution.
Instant save: Pick up and play whenever you want.
Gear system overhaul: Increased(Compass Maze) drops, reduced equipment polishing costs, and lowered refining difficulty — less grind, more fun.
We know this transformation won’t be perfect. But every change was made with sincerity. Old friends, this is still the DongWu you know — only now with a purer adventure. New friends, welcome to the journey.

tr.description:
IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

To every player who loves DongWu: This time, we made a single-player version that never ends.
Dear old friends and new adventurers — it’s been a while.
Why did we turn DongWu Odyssey from an online game into a single-player title?
The reason is simple, and honestly, quite pure.
First, we wanted to give the players who’ve always supported us a place to keep playing — forever. No more worrying about the servers shutting down, no more waking up one day to find you can’t log in. This companionship shouldn’t be cut short by operational problems.
Second, we wanted to make things right. The online version struggled to stay afloat, and what weighs on us even more is that the original design framework led to an unstable experience. Those issues troubled all of you for far too long, and they’ve been a knot in our hearts ever since. So we decided that, at the very end, we would nail the most fundamental, core experience of the game and hand it over, fully and completely, to everyone who loves DongWu. This is something our team can do, and something we should do.
From online to single-player — this is a difficult transformation, but also a brave rebirth. We know this game is still far from perfect, yet it has always carried the original intention of "never letting passion fade." If you’re a returning player, welcome back to relive your memories. If you love Darkest Dungeon-style games, we hope you’ll come explore this world.
Here are the core changes in the single-player version — every one of them made for a more pure playing experience:
All monetization removed. Pay once, play forever. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.

New narrator system: Deepens story immersion and pulls you deeper into the world of DongWu.
Permanent death: Once a character falls, they’re gone for good — no resurrection, no re-recruitment. Every step demands caution.

Gear system overhaul: Increased(Compass Maze) drops, reduced equipment polishing costs, and lowered refining difficulty — less grind, more fun.

IMPORTANT: "Parallel Experiment" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game with escape room-like elements. Each player must have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac (cross-platform play is supported).

In the game players take on the roles of two detectives who are often separated, each with different clues, and must work together to solve puzzles.  Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our community on Discord!

ABOUT THE GAME

Parallel Experiment is a noir-inspired adventure with a comic book art style, featuring detectives Ally and Old Dog. While following the trail of the dangerous Cryptic Killer, they suddenly become his targets and are now unwilling participants in his twisted experiment. 

This is the second standalone chapter in the “Cryptic Killer” cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series. You can play Unboxing the Cryptic Killer first, if you want to learn more about our detectives and their nemesis, but Parallel Experiment can be enjoyed without prior knowledge.

KEY FEATURES

- Two Player Co-Op

​In Parallel Experiment, players must rely on their communication skills as they’re separated and must each discover unique clues that are vital for solving puzzles on the other end. Teamwork is essential to crack the Cryptic Killer’s codes.

- Challenging Collaborative Puzzles

​There are over 80 puzzles striking the perfect balance between challenging yet fair. But you're not facing them on your own! Communicate with your partner on how to best proceed, solve a puzzle on your end that unlocks the next step for them and discover a wide variety of puzzles from redirecting water flows, finding computer passwords and unlocking intricate locks, to deciphering cryptic ciphers, soldering electronic components, and even waking up a drunk!

- Two Can Play That Game

​Looking for a break from the main investigation? Dive into a variety of retro-inspired mini-games designed with a fresh cooperative twist. Challenge each other to darts, Three in a Row, Match Three, Claw Machine, Push and Pull, and more. Think you know these classics? We’ve reinvented them for a whole new co-op experience

- Cooperative Dialogues

​Uncover vital clues through collaborative conversations. NPCs respond dynamically to each player, offering new layers of interaction that only teamwork can unravel. Some conversations are puzzles in themselves that you need to solve together!

- A story told in panels

Our love for comic books shines in Parallel Experiment. Every cutscene is presented as a beautifully crafted comic book page, immersing you in a gripping, noir-inspired narrative.

How many pages did we create to tell the story? Almost 100 pages! Even we were surprised by how much it took, but every panel was worth it to deliver a story that keeps you on edge until the very last frame.

- Draw on… Everything!

​Every detective needs a notebook. In Parallel Experiment, players can jot down notes, sketch solutions, and interact with the environment in creative ways. But we all know what you're going to draw first…

- Annoy Each Other

​This is a key feature? Yes. Yes, it is. ​

​Each level will have some way for players to annoy their co-op partner: knock on a window to distract them, poke them, make their screens shake. You already know you'll be doing this just by reading it, right?



Parallel Experiment has a variety of mind-twisting challenges that push the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design, offering situations never seen before in other games.

pt.description:
致所有热爱《安尼姆》的玩家：
这一次，我们做了款永不落幕的单机版！
各位新老玩家朋友们，好久不见。
为什么我们要把《安尼姆的无尽旅途》从网游改成单机版？
其实原因很简单，也很纯粹：
一是想给一直支持我们的玩家，留一个"可以持续游玩的地方"。不用再担心服务器关闭，某天突然就玩不到了，这份陪伴不该被运营问题打断；
二是想弥补遗憾。网游版的运营一直举步维艰，更让我们愧疚的是，当初的设计框架导致游戏体验不够稳定，这些问题困扰了大家很久，也成了我们心里的疙瘩。所以我们想在最后，把游戏最基础、最核心的体验做好，完整地交到喜欢《安尼姆》的人手里。这是我们项目组能做，也应该做的事。
从网游到单机，这是一次艰难的转型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我们深知这款游戏还不够完美，但它始终承载着"不让热爱落幕"的初心。如果你是老玩家，欢迎回来重拾回忆；如果你喜欢暗黑地牢类游戏，也期待你能来探索这个世界。
下面和大家详细说说单机版的核心改动，每一处都为了更纯粹的游玩体验：
1、彻底删除所有氪金系统，买断制一次付费，畅玩到底；
2、新增"游戏月"机制：替代原网游24小时现实刷新，主线需在倒计时内完成（简单/普通难度时间充裕，高难度更具挑战），同时承载游戏内刷新功能；
3、角色全免费招募：取消固定角色徽章，改为通用徽章升级，招募与升级方式需要大家自行探索；
4、新增旁白系统：强化剧情沉浸感，带你更深入走进安尼姆的世界；
5、角色永久死亡：一旦阵亡无法复活、无法重招，每一步选择都要谨慎；
6、即时存档功能：随开随玩；
7、装备系统优化：提升罗盘秘境产出，降低装备打磨成本和火炼难度，减负更护肝。
我们知道，这次转型可能会有不完美的地方，但每一处改动都凝聚着我们的诚意。老玩家们，这里依然是你们熟悉的安尼姆，却有了更纯粹的冒险；新朋友们，欢迎你们加入这场旅途。

Nesta esperada sequência do jogo “Clouds & Sheep”, as ovelhinhas fofas finalmente estão à solta de novo! Resolva inúmeras missões e atenda às necessidades dos amiguinhos lanudos. Plante pasto, flores, árvores e tosquie a lã de várias cores dos animais para abastecer seus recursos! Colete estrelas felizes, colha madeira e pétalas de flores e use-as para fornecer comida, acessórios, brinquedos e muito mais ao seu bando! Controle as nuvens e faça chover para que suas ovelhas nunca fiquem sem água fresca para beber! Se as ovelhas estiverem felizes e satisfeitas, elas logo terão pequenos cordeirinhos!

Todos os animais precisam da sua atenção! As bolinhas de lã gostam de se divertir. Faça sua ovelha pular e use brinquedos diferentes como a cama elástica, a gangorra e o balanço para brincar com eles! Veja seus bichinhos interagirem entre si e observe as reações deles aos objetos que você lhes dá! Personalize a pastagem do bando com objetos divertidos e escolha entre diversos cenários como Velho Oeste ou Piratas. Veja seu bando correr por aí o dia todo e dormir junto à fogueira de noite. Faça tudo o que puder para manter as ovelhas felizes para evitar que se tornem grandes nuvens de algodão no céu.

Recursos:
- Jogue sem anúncios!
- A incrível continuação do jogo de sucesso “Clouds & Sheep”
- Comece uma aventura épica para encontrar a lendária Fonte da Juventude!
- Jogo de simulação com adoráveis ovelhas
- Cuide bem do seu bando
- Crie lindos e belos cordeirinhos
- Brinque com seus animais
- Dê a eles vários itens e objetos
- Cultive e colha diversos recursos
- Tosquie suas ovelhas
- Personalize sua pastagem
- Controle o clima
- Ciclo de dia e noite
- Jogo de mundo aberto em 3D
- Adequado para crianças e divertido para toda a família

pt.description:
Songs of Conquest Mobile é um jogo de fantasia tática por turnos onde lideras magos poderosos chamados Wielders e te aventuras pelo desconhecido. Trava guerras, desenvolve cidades e povoações, e explora os perigos do mundo de Aerbor.

Combate tático por turnos – Lidera exércitos em batalhas estratégicas onde cada jogada é crucial! Combina magia e força bruta para venceres os teus adversários, ajustando táticas para alcançar a vitória.

Constrói um império – Recolhe recursos, constrói estruturas e organiza os teus exércitos em função do teu estilo de jogo. Cobre o céu de flechas, vai à carga diretamente contra o inimigo ou teletransporta as tuas forças pelo campo de batalha. Tu decides!

Joga a História – Percorre as quatro Songs of Conquest e descobre a história de cada fação em quatro campanhas que te levarão numa aventura pelo mundo de Aerbor.

Quatro Fações – Escolhe entre quatro fações únicas no modo Conquest, onde jogas em mapas gerados aleatoriamente ou em belas experiências personalizadas.
- Loth, uma baronia em declínio que recorre à necromancia para recuperar a sua antiga glória.
- Arleon, os destroços de um império onde só os fortes sobrevivem.
- Rana, tribos ancestrais semelhantes a sapos que lutam pela sobrevivência no seu amado Pântano.
- Barya, mercenários e comerciantes independentes que lutam por quem apresente a melhor oferta.

Jogabilidade otimizada para dispositivos móveis – Desfruta do mundo de Songs of Conquest e da sua experiência envolvente, otimizada para jogar onde quer que estejas.

Requisitos mínimos do dispositivo: iOS 16 ou mais recente e 4 GB de RAM
